blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Highlands Coffee has arrived at the Two Mango Avenue Building, open round the clock from day one. The best part might be that you never have to check the operating hours. Meet the barkada over coffee or camp out with your laptop until late. Night owls finally get a place that’s as awake as they are. Come whenever you’re ready. Fresh coffee, good food, and a table for the whole crew will be waiting. At the counter, the star is the Phin Sua Da. It’s Highlands’ signature Vietnamese iced coffee with condensed milk, brewed through a traditional […]...
